comment: Free-tier model allowlist for opencode --seatbelt free-tier.sb. Each entry binds an exact resolved tuple: opencode provider ID, model key, upstream model.api.id, provider package, and canonical API base URL. The wrapper enforces the -m argument against provider id + model key of this list (fail-closed), and the immutable manifest pins the api.id / SDK / baseURL expectations. Update only via PR review; free-tier pricing can change.
